I have even created CRUD operation using [ the official symfony doc](http://symfony.com/doc/current/bundles/SensioGeneratorBundle/commands/generate_doctrine_crud.html) on this issue, yet again ALL my forms come up with this message. May it be something from configurations or it is a bug. 
I have checked the forms on edit part and on update part (where I land with the CSRF error), but the token is the same.
And when I try to analyse my POST request in Symfony Profiler (Form section), I have the error mentioned by @imulot when he opened this issue.
This is a fresh project, just set up (I started working on it 3 days ago).
I wonder what might cause this and how to fix it.

I did some further investigations. 
I took an older project of mine (one using symfony 2.3) and updated the composer.json to have same configuration as my new project (using symfony 2.4)... it turns out on every form I get same error message (and I cannot access the profiler).

issue.title: [Form][WebProfiler] Key "id" for array with keys "submitted_data, errors, synchronized, children"
issue.body:
SF 2.5.2 - after upgrade from 2.4
Validation in fallback mode

After submit form with errors (fields: text, datetime, collection + some assertions via annotations)
I'm going to webprofiler -> form 

Error:

```
Key "id" for array with keys "submitted_data, errors, synchronized, children" does not exist in @WebProfiler/Collector/form.html.twig at line 417
500 Internal Server Error - Twig_Error_Runtime 
```

body: Steps on how to reproduce this issue given in https://github.com/symfony/symfony/issues/11474#issuecomment-50237986

The problem:
- The form type used by the collection type (when `allow_add` is enabled) is not discovered by the data extractor.
- Thus the data extractor will not generate any configuration data for it (the id is part of this).
- After submitting the form with at least one item in the collection type, it is part of the form data.
- This results that the data collection is requesting more information about this type.
- The data extractor only knows the submitted data at this point, but Twig is going to request more information (like the id).
- This results in the error

Now the problem is clear, we have to find a solution to make the data extractor aware of the form type used by the collection type /cc @webmozart
